title: sharedWorktree delegation write policy is not implemented (501), although the spawn tool schema advertises it
outcome: Reported by Engram::Opus (mailbox #237, 2026-09-25): spawning Kimi as explorer with writePolicy { kind: sharedWorktree, ownedPaths: [target/kimi-review-scratch] } returned 501 'sharedWorktree delegation write policy is not implemented yet'. The termal_spawn_session schema lists sharedWorktree as a writePolicy option, so callers discover the gap only at spawn time. For agents that cannot run readOnly (tm-fy7m) a shared worktree with owned scratch paths would let them read the frozen input in place. Wanted: implement sharedWorktree with ownedPaths enforcement, or remove it from the advertised schema until it exists and say so in the tool description.
